overview.description: A startup lab optimises for repeatability under time pressure. An academic lab optimises for novelty. The equipment looks identical and almost nothing else is.
objectives: Set up an ELN and a documentation culture people will actually keep
Choose a BSL pathway and build to it rather than around it
Make an experiment repeatable by someone who did not run it

steps.intro: A startup lab optimises for repeatability under time pressure. An academic lab optimises for novelty. The equipment looks identical and almost nothing else is.
instructions: Choose an ELN this week. Any of them beats a notebook nobody can search.
Write one protocol so completely that a new hire could run it unaided. Then have them.
Audit your freezer. Unlabelled samples are a liability, not an asset.
